actualites.knowmore.body: Simplify your text with artificial intelligence. We provide you with a rephrasing tool that uses the concepts of Easy-to-Read.
actualites.knowmore.body.how.body: The tool offers a rephrasing of the text using a generative AI that uses a prompt based on the Easy-to-Read concepts. The feature is useful if the text is long enough for the rephrasing to be worthwhile. This is why it must be at least 200 characters long.
actualites.knowmore.body.how.title: How does the tool work?
actualites.knowmore.body.what.body: Easy-to-Read (Easy to Read and Understand) is a writing method that aims to make texts clearer and accessible to everyone. Initially designed to help people with cognitive disabilities, this method is also useful for improving the comprehension of students with reading difficulties or non-native parents. More information about Easy-to-Read
actualites.knowmore.body.what.title: What is Easy-to-Read?
actualites.knowmore.title: Make your communications accessible to as many people as possible
